label: How the parts of the repo connect: data and model bank feed the improve loop, experiments feed the knowledge bank and the significance test

nodes.label: Model bank
nodes.text: Every forecasting model behind one contract: fit on history, return quantile forecasts. Two baselines, the lab's XGBoost ensemble, a PyTorch net and five Nixtla examples. An in-house model plugs in by dotted path (pkg.module:Class) with no registration.

nodes.label: 1. select-model
nodes.text: Stage 1. Fits every candidate family from rolling cutoffs on the 2025-26 window, scores each with phase-aware WIS, and names the incumbent by a goal (metric and phase). Output: a ranking and the family to refine.

nodes.label: 2. improve loop
nodes.text: Stage 2. Evaluate, then Agent 1 diagnoses the weakest phase, horizon or location, then Agent 2 picks one action from a constrained catalog and cites bank entries, then the adapter validates and applies it, the model retrains, and the change is kept only if it beats the best so far. Repeats until the iteration limit, two regressions in a row, or stop.

nodes.label: Forecast pipeline
nodes.text: Config dict in, forecast CSV out. The flu adapter translates each agent action (reweight training rows, set a training window, change a hyperparameter, toggle features, ...) into a config change and checks it against its ranges first; an unknown action is an error.

nodes.label: Knowledge bank
nodes.text: Facts the agent sees before it proposes. Curated entries come from the lab (YAML, reviewed); experiential entries come from our own experiments (one per arm, with per-seed results). Retrieved by phase, model and metric, shown with ids; the loop records which ids the agent cites and drops invented ones.

nodes.label: CDC FluSight data
nodes.text: Weekly state-level flu hospital admissions from the CDC FluSight repository, cached for a week. Every model trains only on data before its cutoff. Experiments record the file's sha256 and refuse to run or test against a different snapshot.

nodes.label: Run tracker + report
nodes.text: Every improve iteration goes into SQLite (runs.db) with its diagnosis, action, citations, config and metrics. Each run writes report.md and report.json: what was tried, where the benefit came from by phase and horizon, and a recommendation.

nodes.label: 3. Experiment harness
nodes.text: Controlled experiments outside the agent: fixed arms (baseline, reweighting, windows, oversampling) over many cutoffs and seeds, on the primary 2025-26 window or the held-out 2024-25 season. Logs every arm; import-experiment writes the results into the knowledge bank.

nodes.label: 4. Significance test
nodes.text: Takes a harness run, pairs candidate and baseline forecasts by forecast date, and runs a two-sided Diebold-Mariano test with a small-sample correction. An improvement counts only if the mean difference is negative and p < 0.05. Not yet wired into the improve loop.
